title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.29132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. translated_title: DeepDOSReasoner：面向态密度预测与材料发现的物理原理驱动推理
translated_abstract: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学领域长期追求的目标。电子态密度（eDOS）和声子态密度（phDOS）决定了材料的关键电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，然而使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算它们的成本高昂：Materials Project数据库中约60%的条目缺少eDOS数据，超过80%的条目缺少phDOS数据。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池化的结构表示和逐点回归，这会模糊光谱特征并违反总态守恒。本研究提出DeepDOSReasoner，这是一个基于物理原理的框架，通过原子到能量源的注意力机制解码光谱，并通过学习到的连续性方程传输过程精炼归一化态密度，从结构上保证非负性和总态守恒。DeepDOSReasoner在eDOS和phDOS的所有评估指标上均取得了最高的预测精度。
tldr: DeepDOSReasoner通过原子-能量源注意力机制与连续性方程传输，在从结构上保证非负性和总态守恒的前提下，实现了电子与声子态密度的高精度预测，助力材料发现。
en_tdlr: DeepDOSReasoner leverages atom-to-energy source attention and continuity-equation transport to achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy for electronic and phonon densities of states, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
